title: Audit section
description: The audit section of an agentic.json file: when agent-audit reports the review of a source as overdue, and the directory whose Markdown files each need a source.

maxAge.description: Days after which a review is overdue.

versionMaxAge.description: Days after which the review of a versioned source is overdue.

coverDir.description: The directory whose Markdown files each need a source. An empty value turns the check off.
